notes.title: WellTown Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34376159/a9eec49fe5d5886488028308229aff65cd9b251b.png[/img]

[b]Hi Folks! We have an update for you! [/b]

But first of all, thank you! Thanks to everyone who has given WellTown a try, commented, reviewed or shared any bugs they have experienced! With your help we have been able to identify some key issues and provide a few fixes: 

Quality-of-life items: 
[list]
[*] Pressing the "R" key will do a full game reset (without having to quit the game and reload it)
[*] Pressing the "S" key within the first 7 seconds will skip the tutorial/avatar select and start the intro
[/list]

Audio items: 
[list]
[*] Added Teleport beam hover audio saying the location's name
[*] Added menu hover audio and click sounds
[*] Added guide foley sounds 
[*] Improved Oriental Bay audio
[/list]

Known Issues: 
Application not closing properly on some devices.Most devices return with a 7-30 delay in application close, while others stay open indefinitely.
Currently investigating if it is a GPU or UE4 Plugin issue
